meta.title: 职场口碑：业绩只占10%，口碑占90%

scenes.context: 讲者开门见山：雇主评价中业绩只占10%，口碑占90%，所以要主动建立口碑。
sentences: 雇主对员工的评价中，业绩只占 10%。
In an employer's evaluation, performance counts for only 10%.
只占：count for only
口碑、职场印象和职场曝光，占了 90%。
Reputation, workplace image, and exposure make up the other 90%.
职场曝光：workplace exposure
刚进入一家公司，就想好要建立什么职场口碑。
When you join a company, decide what reputation you want to build.
建立口碑：build a reputation
paraphrase: 业绩只占10% → 口碑才是大头
Performance is only 10%; reputation is the real weight.
主动建立口碑 → 设计印象
Deliberately build the impression you want.
scenes.speak: In an employer's evaluation, performance counts for only 10%. Reputation, workplace image, and exposure make up the other 90%. When you join a company, decide what reputation you want to build.

scenes.title_cn: 方法一：做自己擅长的事
scenes.title_en: Method one: do what you're good at
scenes.context: 讲者讲正反馈逻辑：做得好→更有兴趣→做得更好，并给出落地方法。
sentences: 最大的痛点，是不知道自己擅长什么。
The real pain is not knowing what you're good at.
最大的痛点：the real pain
不是有兴趣才做得好，而是做得好所以更有兴趣。
You don't excel because you're interested — you get interested because you excel.
因果反转：excel first, interest follows
先启动一个正反馈，形成增强循环。
Kick off a positive feedback loop that keeps strengthening.
正反馈：positive feedback loop
paraphrase: 做得好→有兴趣 → 增强循环
Doing well fuels interest, which fuels doing better.
写任务清单 → 对标高薪要求
List daily tasks and benchmark them against well-paid roles.
scenes.speak: The real pain is not knowing what you're good at. You don't excel because you're interested — you get interested because you excel. Kick off a positive feedback loop that keeps strengthening.

scenes.title_cn: 方法二：文档建立个人标签
scenes.title_en: Method two: documents build your tag
scenes.context: 讲者讲写知识文档放共享平台，为自己而写、留备份，用于面试。
sentences: 让别人一提到某件事，就想到你。
Make people think of you the moment a topic comes up.
一提到就想到：think of you at once
你不是为公司写的，你是为自己写的。
You're not writing for the company — you're writing for yourself.
为自己而写：write for yourself
面试更高薪水的工作时，把文档秀出来。
When interviewing for a higher-paying job, show those documents.
秀出来：show off
paraphrase: 文档=名片 → 建立标签
Your documents are your business card.
留备份 → 为跳槽加分
Keep backups to boost your next interview.
scenes.speak: Make people think of you the moment a topic comes up. You're not writing for the company — you're writing for yourself. When interviewing for a higher-paying job, show those documents.

practice: Reputation counts for 90% of the evaluation.
I'm building a reputation for closing deals.
Success creates a positive feedback loop.
I showed my documents to prove my expertise.
pitfalls: ✓ 地道说法：Do what you're good at.
what you're good at 比 good at things 更地道。
✕ 直译腔：I more interested because do well.
✓ 地道说法：You get interested because you excel.
excel 表达「做得好」更简洁。
✕ 直译腔：Show your documents to prove you are expert.
✓ 地道说法：Show your documents to prove your expertise.
✕ 直译腔：Company judge me only by performance.
✓ 地道说法：Performance counts for only 10% of the evaluation.

把文档当作「给公司的作业」
把文档当作「给自己的资产」
